faq.question: Is collapsible baby stroller allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Collapsible Baby Stroller is restricted in carry-on luggage. Strollers are allowed through security but must be screened. Many airlines require gate-checking or cabin overhead stowage depending on dimensions.

faq.question: Can you pack collapsible baby stroller in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Collapsible Baby Stroller is allowed in checked bags.
